mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `equipment_screenshot` ( equipment_id, serial_number, screenshot_url, screenshot_status, fail_reason, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{data.equipmentId}, #{data.serialNumber}, #{data.screenshotUrl}, #{data.screenshotStatus}, #{data.failReason}, #{data.createTime}, #{data.updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `equipment_screenshot` WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `equipment_screenshot` WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND screenshot_url IS NOT NULL AND screenshot_url != '' ORDER BY update_time DESC LIMIT 1
